question: Does the exact same-issuer product-page JavaScript chunk linked by the archived SOXL page identify an official historical daily AUM/shares/flow endpoint, rather than only a current holdings export?
method: Verify the predecessor archived page SHA and that it contains the exact selected product-page script path once. Perform one no-redirect read-only HTTPS GET to the issuer host, save exact status/headers/time/bytes/SHA, archive bytes to Yanxuan NAS and scoped-readback. Inspect JavaScript source as text only; do not execute. Record bounded contexts for holdings/download/AUM/shares/history and URL-like strings that may reveal an official endpoint. Do not fetch discovered endpoints in this fixed version.
acceptance: A candidate historical source requires an explicit issuer endpoint capable of daily 2011-2022 SOXL fund AUM/shares with original first-public/revision evidence. Script references to current holdings only, a third-party host, or a parameterless download do not qualify the factor.
scientific_boundary: No news, market outcomes, model fit, account, purchase, vendor contact, or qualified forward day. This source probe cannot reopen the failed price-residual receiver; any actual fund-size flow formula needs a separately frozen source and economic test.
stop: Stop after the one official script request regardless of outcome. Never expand to other chunks or discovered URLs without a new plan.
